Its title frames the offer as free merchandise, and the spoken prompt likewise connects answering a question with a free shirt, though parts of that prompt are unclear. These are the observable features of a promotional presentation. The material does not establish whether the prizes were delivered or whether Taco Bell is affiliated with the giveaway; those limits do not, by themselves, establish a scam.
